name: Twisted Mysteries: The Silk is Always Smoother
source:
Shiney and Titania are at Fashion Week in Sugar Lake City to promote Aya's Boutique. Of course, chaos ensues and with each passing minute more and more goes wrong. Can you find out who's behind it all in time to show all your designs?

[from [url=https://rgn87.itch.io/twisted-mysteries-the-silk-is-always-smoother]itch.io[/url]]
